purpose: Declare the parameter policy for the first atomic predictive-model candidate before any claim upgrade from diagnostics to prediction validation.

model_contract.required_form: E_or_nu_pred = standard_baseline(domain, constants, quantum_numbers) + delta_uet_or_ci(domain, locked_parameters, quantum_numbers)
model_contract.missing_predictive_component: fixed-parameter CI/correlated or explicit UET correction operator that predicts helium level corrections rather than fitting holdout rows

parameter_policy.calibration_rows_allowed: Selected He I term-level series rows from helium_transition_assignments.json used by helium_quantum_defect_prediction_gate.
parameter_policy.holdout_rows_forbidden_for_fit: Rows in helium_quantum_defect_holdout_sources.json and CHIANTI overlap rows must not set calibrated quantum defects or correction parameters.
parameter_policy.external_rows_forbidden_for_fit: CHIANTI He I rows are cross-check-only until source-lineage review closes; non-NIST independent rows must be held out from calibration.
parameter_policy.claim_boundary: A locked diagnostic parameter manifest does not turn fitted quantum defects into a first-principles UET prediction.

constants.role: standard hydrogenic energy scale for diagnostic quantum-defect relation
Planck constant in eV s used for photon/energy conversion
constants.limitation: Current code constant is inherited standard physics, not a UET-derived constant.

constants.role: exact SI speed of light used for energy/wavelength conversion

calibrated_parameters.uncertainty_policy: series standard error where available; leave-one-out RMSE fallback for current same-source holdouts

future_locked_parameters_required.required_artifact: CI/correlated or UET atomic correction operator with units and parameter values frozen before holdout evaluation
threshold manifest derived before residual evaluation

evaluation_policy.chianti_rows: cross-check only until lineage/source-version review closes

blocked_claims: the current fitted quantum-defect lane is a first-principles UET prediction
CHIANTI cross-check rows can tune parameters
a future UET correction can be added after seeing holdout residuals without a leakage audit
claim_boundary: This manifest locks the current diagnostic parameter policy and identifies missing future parameters. It does not implement a predictive CI/correlated or UET spectral model.
